model_name: Orbital Economy v7.6 r2 — Energy Kernel v2
notes: v7.6 adds Energy Kernel v2: generation needs a physical operating resource (Power Resource Enabled).
Modes 0-24 are exact-regression protected against v7.5.1 r1; Modes 25-26 exercise the resource-supply and capacity-only shocks.
r2 fixes the r1 runtime defects: perceived (state-based) scarcity in the price channel, and the operating identity scoped to Modes 25-26. See docs/V7_6_R1_TO_R2_FIX_REPORT.md.
